#!/bin/bash
LOG_DIR="/var/log/app"
REPORT="/var/log/log-level-cleanup.log"

separate_by_level() {
    local combined="$1"
    local base="${combined%.*}"
    awk '{
        if($0 ~ /\\bERROR\\b/) print > "'"$base"'_error.log"
        else if($0 ~ /\\bWARN\\b/) print > "'"$base"'_warn.log"
        else if($0 ~ /\\bINFO\\b/) print > "'"$base"'_info.log"
        else if($0 ~ /\\bDEBUG\\b/) print > "'"$base"'_debug.log"
        else print > "'"$base"'_other.log"
    }' "$combined"
}

clean_by_level() {
    local base="$1"
    for level in error warn info debug other; do
        case "$level" in
            error) RETENTION=90 ;;
            warn)  RETENTION=30 ;;
            info|debug|other) RETENTION=7 ;;

        find "$LOG_DIR" -name "*_${level}.log*" -mtime +$RETENTION -exec rm -v {} \; 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
            echo "Deleted (${level}, >${RETENTION}d): $f" >> "$REPORT"
        done
    done
}

for combined in "$LOG_DIR"/combined.log; do
    [ -f "$combined" ] || continue
    separate_by_level "$combined"
    clean_by_level "$combined"
done

echo "=== Cleanup Summary ==="
cat "$REPORT" 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "=== Current files by level ==="
ls -lh "$LOG_DIR"/*_{error,warn,info,debug}.log 2>/dev/null
